subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to correct the sentence by using the denotation of the underlined word.

Mr. Sen is __clever __enough to handle his professional hazards.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"clever"** means quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent. (चतुर)

 
 
• **Example: **The **clever** student solved the complex math problem in just a few minutes.
 
 
 
• **"Intelligent" **refers to having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level. (बुद्धिमान)
 
 
• **Example: **She is an **intelligent** girl who always gets top grades in her class.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Intelligent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bold **(साहसी): Showing a willingness to take risks; confident and courageous.

 
 
• **Example:** His bold decision to start his own business paid off in the end.
 
 
 
• **Foolish **(मूर्ख): Lacking good sense or judgment; unwise.
 
 
• **Example: **It was foolish of him to ignore the warning signs.
 
 
 
• **Callous** (कठोर): Showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others.
 
 
• **Example:** His callous remarks hurt everyone's feelings.
